response.query: What legal, ethical, and technical safeguards (consent wording, MoU elements, de-identification, re-ID risk mitigation) are required to link GSIS/SSS/PhilHealth records with survey data safely?
response.answer: Legal safeguards include informed consent and compliance with data protection laws. Ethical safeguards involve ensuring participant privacy and informed consent. Technical safeguards include de-identification and risk mitigation for re-identification.
